intro: Awaken in the middle of the night to a terrifying nightmare. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, avoid sinister creatures, and fight to survive until dawn.
description:
Every night begins the same way—you wake up trapped inside a terrifying nightmare where fear lurks around every corner. Explore dark and unsettling environments, search for clues, and uncover the truth hidden within a world where reality and nightmares have become one.

Venture through eerie locations filled with disturbing sights, mysterious puzzles, and relentless supernatural threats. Every room may hide a valuable clue, a useful item, or a deadly creature waiting in the darkness. Stay alert, manage your resources carefully, and use your wits to survive.

As the nightmare grows more intense, you'll face increasingly dangerous encounters that test your courage and determination. Solve environmental puzzles, unlock new paths, and piece together the mystery behind the horrors haunting your sleep before it's too late.

Will you escape the nightmare, or become trapped within it forever?

Features:

First-person psychological horror gameplay.
Explore eerie locations filled with secrets and hidden paths.
Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and uncover the story.
Evade terrifying supernatural creatures and survive tense encounters.
Search for useful items and resources to aid your escape.
Immersive atmosphere with haunting visuals and chilling sound design.
A suspenseful horror experience that keeps you on edge from beginning to end.
